methods.attn: native FA2 MLA attention, every selected row near (compute floor, no transfer)
methods.copy: Memcpy: unique far rows gathered (host: CPU index_select into pinned memory, not timed; peer: GPU index_select, timed) then H2D/D2D-copied near, then native attention
methods.direct: native attention reading far rows in place, every reference separately
methods.batch: our batched Host kernel, staged: in-kernel dedup, fetch CTAs overlap far reads with near attention
methods.batch_inplace: our batched Host kernel reading far pages in place (host_stage=False), no cache
